title: Per-Slot Worktree Architecture — Structural Multi-Chat Isolation + Fleet Hygiene
description: PIVOT from WORKTREE-CONSOLIDATE-MS0 (recovery-tool framing) to prevention-by-structure. The shared-tree pain — index.lock races, peer-file auto-staging, 48-worktree drift, 5,481-file dirty noise, leaked stashes, empty commits from a fake lint-staged config — keeps recurring because there is no STRUCTURAL separation between the 7 concurrent chats. Recovery tools cannot fix that; only architecture can. Target end state: 8 work slots (alpha..foxtrot + hotel + india) + golf (hygiene/integrator) = 9 canonical worktrees at H:/prism-slot-<name>, each on its own slot/<name> branch; H:/PRISM (main) becomes integration-only — slot chats READ it, never WRITE to it; only golf (integrator) fast-forwards cad-fusion-live-ms0. 8 chats can git commit concurrently with ZERO serialization because each touches a different .git/worktrees/<wt>/index.lock and a different ref lock.
goals: Eliminate the shared-tree commit-collision class by giving every chat its own worktree + branch
Reduce active worktree count from ~49 toward ~9 canonical + a bounded set of in-flight feature trees
Land the migration tooling (audit-worktrees, cherry-pick-consolidator, slot-worktree-bootstrap) so the drain is repeatable
Fix the root-cause infra bugs surfaced along the way (fake lint-staged config, push_delete guard false-positive)

deliverables: .claude/hooks/git-add-lane-guard.mjs — net-new PreToolUse(Bash) hook; default-OFF env-opt-in (PRISM_GIT_ADD_LANE_ENABLE=1); kill switch PRISM_GIT_ADD_LANE_DISABLE=1

.claude/hooks/bundles/bash-bundle.mjs — wired after sibling worktree-commit-route, same 2000ms budget
U-P1-ADD-LANE-GUARD.note: Dedup decision: NET-NEW. Coverage map: pre-edit-lane-guard.mjs covers Edit/Write/MultiEdit by peer-CLAIM; file-claim-commit-guard.mjs covers `git commit` by peer-CLAIM (and `git add` chained with commit); worktree-commit-route.mjs covers `git commit` by worktree mismatch. The gap this hook fills = BARE `git add` by SLOT WORKTREE SCOPE — a different concern (slot lane vs file claim) and a different trigger (unchained add). Confirmed by reading all three sibling hook headers. Build-time P0 caught + fixed during work: original top-level `exit(0)` activation gate killed any test harness doing `await import(...)`. Smoke harness printed 'boot' then silently died inside the import. Fix moved `if (!isHookArmed()) exit(0)` INSIDE main(); the smoke harness's `await import(...)` is now the import-safety regression assertion. Per-file 3-of-3 scrutiny PASS (code-analyzer + reviewer, both PASS). 4 P1 hygiene items from reviewer all fixed in the same commit: P1-B3 payload.cwd precedence, P1-B4 smoke env-isolation, P1-B1 +2 quote-escape cases, P1-B5 +2 malformed-porcelain cases. Today-state (pre-cutover, all chats in H:/prism on cad-fusion-live-ms0) the hook is a near-no-op even when armed (single worktree → no out-of-scope possible); becomes meaningful POST-P3-CUTOVER when each slot has its own `H:/prism-slot-<name>` worktree.

U-P1-MAINTREE-WRITE-BLOCK.note: P1-ROUTING phase now 3/3 complete (U-P1-ROUTE-ACTIVATE e2340001a + U-P1-ADD-LANE-GUARD b4118a7f0 + U-P1-MAINTREE-WRITE-BLOCK 10c5e40c3 all shipped, all default-OFF env-opt-in pending P3-DEFAULT-ON). Honest bug discovery: while writing this hook + spawning its smoke harness against state/shared/chat-slots.json, found that BOTH this hook AND the already-shipped U-P1-ADD-LANE-GUARD's resolveSlotScope were treating slots.slots as Array<{slot,state}> — but the real schema is { [slotName]: state | null } (object keyed by slot name; state inline; idle slots literal null). Both hooks would throw TypeError the moment they were armed. Latent (default-OFF in production, never fired) — back-fixed in the same commit so the second unit doesn't ship a broken first. Agent B grep confirmed no other callers of slots.slots.find in tree (sibling helpers heartbeat-keepalive + golf-slot-write-allowlist were already schema-correct). Per-file 3-of-3 scrutiny PASS (code-analyzer + reviewer, both PASS). 3 P2 deferrable items logged: MAIN_TREE_ROOT could become a knob, golf-exemption docblock could backlink CLAUDE.md §GOLF SLOT, CWD precedence could note load-bearing source.
